response.overview: Tonight’s Chad’s (Chad Alva) big league tournament final and his wife (Natasha Nice), knows how to celebrate in victory or defeat. It surprises Chad to learn that Natasha is serious about her fantasy; the one where she’s gangbanged by her husband’s entire team (John Strong, Rex-Ryder). He thought she was kidding. But when Chad brings home the team to celebrate their victory, he soon discovers that there’s an excitingly nasty side to his wife…
response.title: Pass Around Wives (Chapter 1)
